latest_release.name: v1.1.0 · Swiss style and community-ready release
latest_release.body:
## Highlights

- Added Style B Swiss International workflow and documentation.
- Added Codex image generation guidance for deck visuals and covers.
- Added Swiss map component guidance for geography, history, and location relationship slides.
- Added contribution guide, issue templates, and pull request template.
- Updated repository metadata, topics, and enabled Discussions.

## Validation

- Swiss deck validator is available at `scripts/validate-swiss-deck.mjs`.
- New community templates are included under `.github/`.
